## Checklist

- [ ] I kept all required arms and did not select only favorable results.
- [ ] I did not commit private material, credentials, raw restricted data or executable model files.
- [ ] I distinguished public-data reproduction from an independent blind test.
- [ ] I understand automated checks do not constitute scientific acceptance or an authorship guarantee.
